title: Slimy Friends
description: Have fun with 4 new slimy little friends
body:
Get ready to see some slimes!\
Slimy Friends adds 4 new slimes: Green, Blue, Orange and Purple.\
![orange slime image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14b294b53c4ea0908a7babeb0d37286926ca9417.png)

You can bring these slimes home and farm them and harvest them for their gel.\
Different color gels burn for longer in the furnace\
The green gel smelts 2 iron ingots\
The blue gel smelts 3 iron ingots\
the orange smelts 4 and the purple smelts 5.\
![smelting iron ore to iron image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1eb3c4398441efb438a14df5ce60e361ad0cebff.png)

You can also turn the gels into a compact block for smelting
![block of gel recipe image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f87bf83aeea6c883961c0a0b79755a9b8cea7489.png)\
These slimes are really like farmable fuel sources


Footnote:\
This is my first mod I made without MCreator so please tell me if there are any bugs in my [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/Kn5XarnVd8) server\
You can also go there for any suggestions
